call_points.text: Management committed to repaying ₹140 Cr of debt annually for the next three years, with potential to prepay more.
No major capex is planned for the next two years, with tight control on capital expenditures.
Domestic formulation revenues fell to ₹173.9 Cr from ₹185.1 Cr YoY due to poor season in anti-infectives and respiratory.
Trade receivables elongated due to strong growth in emerging markets exports where credit periods are longer.
Warren Remedies API site will take about one more year to receive regulated market approvals.

operating_notes.text: Divesting ophthalmic business (3.2% of FY25 revenue) to Sunways for ₹110 Cr to focus on core therapeutic areas.
Recommended dividend of ₹0.20 per equity share (10%) on face value of ₹2 for FY26.
Warren Remedies API plant is currently undergoing product validations and will take about one more year for regulated market approvals.
Company holds ₹23 Cr idle land classified as held for sale on the balance sheet at book value.
Baddi Unit-I solid oral dosage facility successfully cleared Malta Medicines Authority audit with EU GMP certification.
Completed the slump sale of the Ophthalmic Division in India and 16 African territories to Sunways (India) Private Limited.
Baddi Plant III Oral Solid Dosage facility received EU GMP certification from German Health Authority (Berlin) following April 2026 inspection.
Regulated international formulations business recorded 21.1% YoY growth in Q2FY27.
Incorporated Warren Lifesciences Private Limited as a 100% wholly-owned subsidiary on 26 September 2026.
AnaCipher received ANVISA Brazil approval for clinical and bioanalytical facilities.

timeline.summary: Indoco Remedies Limited scheduled an earnings conference call on audited Q4 FY2025-26 results for May 7, 2026, at 3:30 PM IST, led by Aditi Panandikar, Sundeep V. Bambolkar, and Pramod Ghorpade.
Approved the sale of the ophthalmic business in India and 16 African territories to Sunways (India) Private Limited for ₹110 Cr.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹475.61 Cr, net loss to shareholders ₹21.64 Cr (against a loss of ₹40.39 Cr a year earlier).
In Q4FY26 earnings call, Indoco guided for ₹140 Cr annual debt repayments over next 3 years with no major capex planned.
Indoco Remedies received EU GMP certification from Malta Medicines Authority for its solid oral dosage Unit-I facility at Baddi.
Indoco Remedies completed the slump sale transfer of its Ophthalmic Division to Sunways (India) Private Limited on May 18, 2026.
Indoco Remedies received EU GMP certification from German Health Authority (Berlin) for its Baddi Plant III oral solid dosage facility.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹520.17 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹18.38 Cr (against a loss of ₹7.93 Cr a year earlier).
Indoco Remedies announced on October 27, 2026, that its CRO AnaCipher received ANVISA Brazil approval for its clinical and bioanalytical facilities.
